does: Makes the engine's memory manager: a critical section, a pool size of 0x68000000 bytes (1,664 MB) at +0xD0 (another for GameObjectFileMerger.exe), the system allocator's usage counters; the 1,664 MB arena is committed at the process start, drawn or not.

evidence.says: CoreLib.dll+0x8F040 (unnamed) writes 0x68000000 at +0xD0 and checks the module name against GameObjectFileMerger.exe; the macOS ls::MemoryManager::GetInstance initialiser writes the same 0x68000000
Ext.Debug.MemoryMap at the first Lua (client LoadModule): one committed private region of 0x68030000 bytes, headless and drawn alike, beside one of 0x82610000 (2,086 MB)

questions.ask: Who commits the 2,086 MB region (0x82610000), and is the arena size a setting that a headless game could lower with the logic unchanged?
